name: run5-circuit-level-locked-v1
design_provenance: Noise settings were selected after small exploratory infrastructure pilots with different seeds. Distances, endpoint, sample sizes, and all reported-run seeds were frozen before this locked run.

regimes.reference: A stationary circuit with independent data-X faults in every round.
regimes.correlated: A separate stationary post-change circuit with common-plus-residual paired data-X faults in every round. There is no within-circuit transition.

primary_endpoint.positive_value_means: correlation-aware decoding has lower logical error

claim_boundary: This is a controlled Stim/PyMatching circuit simulation, not hardware evidence.
The injected post-change correlation channel and both decoder models are known.
The experiment evaluates decoder utility; it does not test sequential drift-detection advantage.
No claim is made of quantum acceleration, universal sample efficiency, or superiority to an oracle decoder.
